title: BESTÅ TV storage combination/glass doors
description: BESTÅ TV storage combination/glass doors, white/Selsviken high gloss/beige frosted glass, 707/8x161/2x755/8" BESTÅ TV storage combinations provide a home for your TV and storage for the gadgets you need for all the activities around it. features: We recommend a TV bench to be a bit wider than the TV placed on it. This TV bench suits a TV up to 72 inches. You can choose a larger TV if it’s not heavier than the specified max load for the bench’s top.
The top panel of the TV bench is intended for a TV with a maximum weight of 55 lbs.
Doesn't match GLASSVIK fronts or BESTÅ top panels bought earlier than October 2022.
The clear glass has slightly green tone.
The max load for a wall-hung frame depends on the wall material.

The push-open function requires a space between the frame and the drawer front to allow the drawer to be pushed to open. The small gap is necessary to allow this function and is not a product deviation.
